title: Prove the sharp five-term pair-reader floor over every field
body:
## Summary

```text
rank(U) + rank(Q) <= 7
  -> one factor side has rank <= 3
  -> 23 seven-point types: 22 GF16 + selective non-Fano transfer
  -> preserve the literal pair operator while shrinking both supports
  -> sum C(u_i,q_i) >= m_A + m_B
```

Prove the sharp actual-reader complete-plane tariff for **every at-most-five-term** realization of two disjoint alternating-half indicators, over every coefficient field and even binary-orthonormal partition. Queries and readers may have arbitrary external directions and values. This closes PR3489/PR3506's five-term pair gap.

The new certificate classifies all seven-point rank-three incidence systems. Two implementations check the finite premises; the [proof](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9401bc44952089a8742e95bfc378e50ef298ede7/research/p112-five-term-reader-floor/PROOF.md) supplies the support transfer and tariff argument. Exact PR3506 template/proof bytes and attribution are retained locally, with the templates rechecked. No pending Git object is needed for replay. Credit stays with Philippe Van Velzen's expanded-identity method, ctoth, Tekalign and the preceding paired-plane/actual-reader lineage.

This is a scoped negative result. Six terms, three or more targets, changed fitting matrices and shared physical operations remain outside the theorem. It is not a global P112 floor or a native/physical supplier, and changes no selected frontier or kappa. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3489 proved four terms; PR3506 covered the non-Fano five-ray case and left other seven-point patterns open.
  **After:** complete coverage of 23 rank-three types, 22 explicit GF16 representations, and the remaining selective non-Fano case. A second pair-disjoint-line construction matches all **8,390 labeled systems**, including the rank-two orbit.
- Each implementation checks **2,816 subset ranks** and all **21 marked non-Fano pairs** (288 source and 672 reader premises). Seven corruptions reject through actual optimized CLIs; restored positives and two private-copy controls pass.
- CPython **3.12.15** registered replay, focused Ruff/format checks, exact final-head `check_research_commit.py --check-source-history`, official export integrity, and all three optimized Git-free export replays pass at `9401bc44952089a8742e95bfc378e50ef298ede7`. Source/export identities remain unchanged. Optional all-rule Ruff diagnostics and unrun obligations are disclosed in `VALIDATION.md`.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-five-term-reader-floor
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p112-five-term-reader-floor --check-source-history
```

The package README gives direct and Git-free export commands. Canonical baseline `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6, was refreshed before submission with no guidance changes. [Canonical investigation and overlap context](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19010795).

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Fourteen new files under one research package. No shared code, frozen predecessor or selected-result file changes. Mathematical acceptance still requires review of the written proof and finite certificate.
